span.p:
Research/ML (1M req/day)
Sampling: 100% all
Retention: 180 days
Eval: 20
Cost: 1,500 USD/month
Best For: Model eval

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Real-time Agent (100K req/day)
Sampling: 100% with 100ms SLA
Retention: 7 days
Eval: 4
Cost: 200 USD/month
Best For: Low-latency apps

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
Key: Sampling is the most powerful cost lever.
10% tail-based → 50% cost reduction,
78% anomaly coverage
5% tail-based → 75% cost reduction,
65% anomaly coverage
2% tail-based → 90% cost reduction,
42% anomaly coverage
